Overview

Uyo is a city in Akwa Ibom with a population of 500,000. The capital of Akwa Ibom State, a rapidly developing city in the Niger Delta region of southern Nigeria. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
